about: Industrial LPG (liquefied petroleum gas) is mainly propane and butane. With oxygen it is used for flame cutting and heating of steel, and it fuels furnaces, ovens and drying and heating processes where a clean-burning fuel is required.
LPG is heavier than air and pools at floor level if it leaks. Store cylinders upright in ventilated areas away from ignition sources and drains, and use regulators and hoses made for LPG.

faq.question: Is this LPG for home use?
faq.answer: This page covers industrial LPG cylinders for cutting, heating and process use. For domestic cooking-gas connections, please contact your authorised LPG distributor.
